cases.standard:
The Parties acknowledge that any breach of this Agreement may cause irreparable harm for
which monetary damages may be inadequate, and that the Disclosing Party shall be entitled
to seek injunctive and other equitable relief, in addition to any other remedies available at law
or in equity, without the necessity of posting a bond.
cases.alternative:
The Receiving Party acknowledges that the disclosure or unauthorized use of Confidential
Information would cause irreparable harm and that monetary damages alone would be
insufficient. The Disclosing Party shall be entitled to seek injunctive relief in addition to all
other remedies available at law or in equity.
